title: Log-time touches citation sweep with exclusions, feature linkage on decide events
action: Per plan v2 kds-1 (D1a). (1) In do_log (verbs_read.rs), after the event append (seam post-:634, touches full ids in scope at :614-619, new id at :640): for EACH resolved touches: id, call sweep_decision_citations(root, full_id, short8) (render.rs:419). Filter hits: drop docs/decisions/index.md (generated, regenerated by decisions render) and any path under docs/history/<bound-feature>/ when the calling context has a bound feature (self-citation of live work is not staleness). Each surviving hit enqueues a capture stub via the add_capture_stub shape (supersede.rs:56-85): source "touches-sweep", dids [touched_id, new_id], files [hit.file], outcome naming file:line, the touched id, and the new deciding id. Supersede's own sweep untouched. (2) Stamp feature on every new decide event: resolve the calling context's active feature exactly as state route does (session-bound-lane-else-default); insert event field "feature" only when resolution yields one. Legacy lines and all readers unchanged (absent tolerated). (3) Sync decision-memory/overview.md: one data-dictionary line for the new feature field and one line for the touches-sweep behavior under the R2/R2a rules (keep frontmatter canonical). Tests (decisions/tests.rs): touches log enqueues one stub per surviving citing file; index.md hit excluded; own-history hit excluded when feature bound; no touches -> no sweep call; feature field present when a feature is bound and absent otherwise; supersede sweep behavior unchanged.

truths: a decisions log with touches: enqueues capture stubs for citing docs, excluding the generated index and the bound feature's own history dir
new decide events carry feature when a feature is bound; absent otherwise; legacy reads unaffected
supersede's existing sweep is byte-for-byte unchanged in behavior
decision-memory/overview.md documents the feature field and touches-sweep with canonical frontmatter
